clauses: For background and all recipe origins use a shared mixture: 90% lognormal USD median 35, log-SD 1.0; 10% lognormal median 1800, log-SD 1.0; truncate by rejection to [0.01,15000], round half-up to cents. Recipe-specific amount relations are allowed but use the same rounding, jitter and cents distribution across origins. No origin-specific precision.
5..12 payments over 1..7d; recipe amounts drawn continuous USD 5000..13000, with common cent rounding; earlier same-profile large-payment history may defeat rate change. No forced positive label.
findings.not_inferred: Continuous does not imply uniform. No uniform S4 distribution is assumed here.
findings.reason: The shared mixture for all recipe origins has support below USD 5000 and above USD 13000, whereas S4 recipe amounts are confined to USD 5000..13000. The permission for recipe-specific amount relations does not specify whether this absolute range conditions the mixture or replaces it, nor define a replacement density. Both choices affect opportunity support and shortcuts. Common cent rounding does not settle the amount law.
findings.required_resolution: Version an explicit precedence and sampling rule for S4 and its matched H3 mechanism, including whether the shared mixture is conditioned on the range, how Independent scaling/bounds apply, and which rounding/jitter rules are shared. Keep existing Stage 15 bytes unchanged.

findings.classification: Episode versus motif size is not resolved
clauses: Event budgets allocated before targets. Episode sizes are discrete uniform8..20 conditioned only on completing the budget, with any residual<8 assigned to background and reported. Continuous start times uniform over fitting intervals; no forced30d blocks. Same episode-size law for positive-intended and hard origins. Strength U(0.1,0.9), never label input.
4..12 subject events across5..60min; value dispersion from a common Dirichlet(1,1,...) allocation; total amount sampled from shared value process; both dominant and diffuse payments possible.
6..16 subject events over 3..20h with independent inter-arrival jitter, across3..8 proposed occupied hours; may cross UTC midnight. Full daily counts remain causal.
5..16 services over 0.25..3h to 2..8 wallets; bursts can span the 1h boundary; activity count baseline uses preceding28d.
findings.reason: The common episode law assigns 8..20 events, while named recipes specify 4..12, 6..16 or 5..16 events/services. Preparatory/pre-onset events are allowed in the budget, so this need not be a mathematical contradiction. However, the mapping of a 20-event episode to a maximum-12-event motif, and a maximum-16-event motif to an 8-event episode, is unspecified. Silently truncating, splitting, padding or overriding a range changes the population law.
findings.required_resolution: State whether recipe counts describe a motif within the full episode; define count sampling conditional on the episode budget and the roles, timing, amounts and provenance of remaining events, with matched hard-origin treatment.
